name: Ougi Karasuke
source:
A strange young man who lives an irregular lifestyle. It's hard to tell if he's even employed or not. 
Sometimes he'll disappear for the entire day, other times he'll stick around playing with his birds. 
He doesn't like people prying into his business, and never seems to show up on the surveillance footage.
